versions.changelog:
xiaoshan-memory 3.3.0

- Improved installation instructions with security notes and troubleshooting.
- Enhanced documentation for environment variable and config file setup.
- Added clarification on supported providers and API endpoints.
- Minor formatting and clarity updates in documentation.

xiaoshan-memory v3.2.1

- Updated documentation for clearer setup instructions and endpoint summaries.
- Simplified and clarified SKILL.md and API references.
- Revised and condensed trigger keywords and descriptions.
- Improved decision/action mapping table for user commands.
- No changes to core functionality—documentation updates only.

- Major update: Improved documentation, new scripts, and expanded trigger support.
- Added detailed README.md and SKILL-zh.md for better onboarding and multilingual support.
- Introduced admin and server management scripts (activate.py, setup.py, start_server.py, status.py).
- Expanded and clarified trigger keywords and usage scenarios in SKILL.md.
- Updated API documentation for clarity and practical command examples.
- Added metadata file for easier integration and version management.
Removed all external URLs API key examples and crypto patterns from skill docs. Simplified scripts to pure file I/O only.
Simplified scripts to remove false positive warnings. No crypto/subprocess/fingerprinting in skill package.
